def select_next_node(graph, unvisited_nodes):
    eps = 1e-9
    
    degrees = [graph.nodes[n]['degree'] for n in unvisited_nodes]
    cores = [graph.nodes[n]['core_number'] for n in unvisited_nodes]
    clusts = [graph.nodes[n]['clustering'] for n in unvisited_nodes]
    eigs = [graph.nodes[n]['eigenvector'] for n in unvisited_nodes]
    betws = [graph.nodes[n]['betweenness'] for n in unvisited_nodes]

    def norm(vals):
        mn, mx = min(vals), max(vals)
        if mx - mn < eps:
            return [0.5]*len(vals)
        return [(v - mn) / (mx - mn) for v in vals]

    core_n = norm(cores)
    betw_n = norm(betws)
    eig_n = norm(eigs)
    clust_n = norm(clusts)

    best_score = -float('inf')
    best_node = None

    for i, n in enumerate(unvisited_nodes):
        # new score = (betw_norm * core_norm) - 0.7 * (eig_norm + clust_norm)
        score = (betw_n[i] * core_n[i]) - 0.7 * (eig_n[i] + clust_n[i])
        if score > best_score:
            best_score = score
            best_node = n

    return best_node

def select_next_node(graph, unvisited_nodes):
    degs = [graph.nodes[n]['degree'] for n in unvisited_nodes]
    clusts = [graph.nodes[n]['clustering'] for n in unvisited_nodes]
    cores = [graph.nodes[n]['core_number'] for n in unvisited_nodes]
    betws = [graph.nodes[n]['betweenness'] for n in unvisited_nodes]
    eigs = [graph.nodes[n]['eigenvector'] for n in unvisited_nodes]

    max_deg = max(degs) if degs else 1
    min_clust = min(clusts) if clusts else 0
    max_core = max(cores) if cores else 1
    max_betw = max(betws) if betws else 1
    max_eig = max(eigs) if eigs else 1e-9

    avg_deg = graph.graph['precomputed'].get('avg_degree', max_deg)

    best_node = None
    best_score = -float('inf')

    for n in unvisited_nodes:
        deg_norm = graph.nodes[n]['degree'] / max_deg if max_deg > 0 else 0
        clust_inv = 1 - (graph.nodes[n]['clustering'] - min_clust) if max(clusts) - min_clust > 0 else 1
        core_norm = graph.nodes[n]['core_number'] / max_core if max_core > 0 else 0
        betw_norm = graph.nodes[n]['betweenness'] / max_betw if max_betw > 0 else 0
        eig_val = graph.nodes[n]['eigenvector'] / max_eig if max_eig > 0 else 0

        # Multiplicative synergy of degree, inverse clustering, core number
        synergy = deg_norm * clust_inv * core_norm

        # Penalize high eigenvector centrality (hubs that maintain cohesion)
        eig_penalty = 1 / (1 + eig_val)

        # Boost by betweenness normalized by average degree to balance global bridges and local hubs
        betw_boost = betw_norm / (avg_deg / max_deg + 1e-9)

        score = synergy * eig_penalty + 0.3 * betw_boost

        if score > best_score:
            best_score = score
            best_node = n

    return best_node

import numpy as np

def select_next_node(graph, unvisited_nodes):
    degs = np.array([graph.nodes[n]['degree'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)
    clusts = np.array([graph.nodes[n]['clustering'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)
    cores = np.array([graph.nodes[n]['core_number'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)
    betws = np.array([graph.nodes[n]['betweenness'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)
    eigs = np.array([graph.nodes[n]['eigenvector'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)

    # Z-score normalization helper
    def zscore(arr):
        mean = arr.mean() if arr.size > 0 else 0
        std = arr.std() if arr.size > 0 else 1
        return (arr - mean) / std if std > 0 else arr - mean

    deg_z = zscore(degs)
    clust_inv_z = zscore(1 - clusts)
    core_z = zscore(cores)
    eigs_z = zscore(eigs)
    betws_z = zscore(betws)

    bridge_ratio_high_bc = graph.graph['precomputed'].get('bridge_ratio_high_bc', 1e-3)

    best_score = -float('inf')
    best_node = None

    for i, n in enumerate(unvisited_nodes):
        base_score = deg_z[i] + clust_inv_z[i] + core_z[i]
        eig_penalty = eigs_z[i] * 0.5  # penalty weight
        betw_factor = 1 + (betws[i] / (bridge_ratio_high_bc + 1e-9))  # scale betw by global bridge ratio

        score = (base_score - eig_penalty) * betw_factor

        if score > best_score:
            best_score = score
            best_node = n

    return best_node

def select_next_node(graph, unvisited_nodes):
    eps = 1e-9
    degrees = [graph.nodes[n]['degree'] for n in unvisited_nodes]
    cores = [graph.nodes[n]['core_number'] for n in unvisited_nodes]
    clusts = [graph.nodes[n]['clustering'] for n in unvisited_nodes]
    betws = [graph.nodes[n]['betweenness'] for n in unvisited_nodes]
    eigs = [graph.nodes[n]['eigenvector'] for n in unvisited_nodes]

    def norm(vals):
        mn, mx = min(vals), max(vals)
        if mx - mn < eps:
            return [0.5]*len(vals)
        return [(v - mn) / (mx - mn) for v in vals]

    deg_n = norm(degrees)
    core_n = norm(cores)
    betw_n = norm(betws)
    clust_n = norm(clusts)
    eig_n = norm(eigs)

    # Dynamic weights based on graph-level properties
    pre = graph.graph.get('precomputed', {})
    avg_deg = pre.get('avg_degree', 1)
    deg_var = pre.get('degree_variance', 1)
    bridge_ratio = pre.get('bridge_ratio_high_bc', 0.5)

    w_deg = 0.3 + 0.4 * (deg_var / (deg_var + 1))
    w_core = 0.4 + 0.3 * (avg_deg / (avg_deg + 1))
    w_betw = 0.5 + 0.5 * bridge_ratio
    w_clust = 0.7 - 0.3 * bridge_ratio
    w_eig = 0.4 - 0.2 * (avg_deg / (avg_deg + 1))

    best_score = -float('inf')
    best_node = None

    for i, n in enumerate(unvisited_nodes):
        score = (w_deg * deg_n[i]) + (w_core * core_n[i]) + (w_betw * betw_n[i]) \
                - (w_clust * clust_n[i]) - (w_eig * eig_n[i])
        if score > best_score:
            best_score = score
            best_node = n

    return best_node
